basics.name: Eugene Hyrol
basics.label: Software Engineering Manager & Mobile Systems Architect
basics.summary: Software Engineering Manager and Mobile Systems Architect with 9+ years of experience steering high-scale mobile initiatives and leading cross-functional engineering organizations in fintech and retail. Proven track record leading multi-disciplinary squads of up to 15 FTEs (iOS, Android, Backend, QA) on tier-1 mobile banking platforms serving 3.6M+ active users, and architecting secure, resilient mobile systems compliant with OWASP MSTG standards. Experienced engineering leader committed to technical rigor, developer velocity, defect root cause analysis, and developing high-performing talent through formal mentorship and structured hiring.

work.position: Software Engineering Manager · Mobile Tech Lead
work.summary: Steering cross-functional engineering execution and mobile systems architecture for tier-1 banking institutions and retail AI modules.

subProjects.name: Mobile Banking E-Commerce Platform (Tier-1 Polish Bank)
points: Delivered first-in-Poland mobile banking e-commerce marketplace integration for a tier-1 bank serving 3.6 million active users, directing a 15-person cross-functional squad (iOS, Android, Backend, QA) as one of 5 collaborative engineering teams.
Architected and owned critical cart and checkout screens in modular SwiftUI, establishing fault-tolerant transaction handling, clean API boundaries, and seamless cryptographic payment handoffs.

Mitigated release risk and regression escapes across distributed repositories by introducing rigorous automated verification gates, including snapshot regression testing, unit test standards, and automated end-to-end suites.
Drove team-wide Root Cause Analysis (RCA) investigations, serving as the key lead resolving production defect regressions and fortifying release stability across checkout and transaction flows.

subProjects.name: Conversational AI Shopping Assistant (E-Grocery Platform)
points: Delivered end-to-end conversational AI shopping assistant to production in August 2025 by leading an 8-engineer team (3 Backend, 3 Frontend, 2 QA) from architecture to production release.

Governed technical architecture and cloud integration for the conversational runtime in Azure Foundry, taking key technical decisions on data contracts with core Products Catalog APIs, facilitating stress testing, and designing proactive mitigation approaches.
De-risked client-side platform adoption by successfully migrating an exploratory Flutter PoC into an enterprise React Native module embedded cleanly inside the host e-grocery application.

work.summary: Led mobile security audits and enterprise UI component engineering for automotive and financial clients.
highlights: Executed technical security audits for automotive iOS apps: remediated static/dynamic analysis vulnerabilities, implemented secure Keychain storage, and hardened network transport against MITM attacks.
Designed and implemented a reusable UI Component Library in SwiftUI adhering to Atomic Design principles.
Mentored junior developers, conducted technical interviews for iOS candidates across all levels, and aligned closely with security specialists.
points: Hardened mobile security defenses against zero-day and MITM threats across automotive and banking applications by remediating 40+ static/dynamic vulnerabilities, enforcing encrypted iOS Keychain persistence, and aligning with OWASP MSTG standards.
Standardized UI velocity and design-engineering parity by architecting an enterprise-grade SwiftUI Component Library grounded in Atomic Design principles in tight alignment with UX design teams.

Raised engineering hiring bar and organizational talent density by conducting 30+ technical iOS interviews and providing structured 1-on-1 career mentorship, directly guiding at least 2 engineers to formal promotions.

Expanded regional talent pipelines during the COVID-19 pandemic by co-organizing a free community mobile development training bootcamp, serving as lead iOS mentor, tutor, and presenter, and directly converting top graduates into full-time engineering hires.

work.summary: Led an iOS development team on core mobile banking products, security authorization protocols, and greenfield applications.
highlights: Led a team of 5 iOS developers, driving technical mentorship, knowledge sharing, and rigorous code reviews.
Implemented 3D Secure transaction authorization by integrating a third-party biometric and cryptographic SDK.
Designed and coordinated greenfield architecture for a new mobile banking app targeting a fresh customer demographic.
Conducted root cause analysis (RCA) for production defects, boosting crash-free session rates.
points: Steered team of 5 iOS engineers through feature delivery, establishing peer review standards, clean architecture practices, and technical roadmaps.
Enforced banking regulatory payment compliance by architecting 3D Secure biometric and cryptographic transaction flows utilizing hardware-backed authentication.
Architected greenfield retail banking application utilizing modular VIPER and reactive data flows (RxSwift) to capture a next-generation demographic.
Elevated application production stability by driving disciplined telemetry instrumentation and Root Cause Analysis for client-side crash events.

work.summary: Enhanced core banking mobile features, security hardening, and developer tooling automation.
highlights: Integrated automated project generation tooling (xcodegen), eliminating Git merge conflicts across large engineering teams.
Implemented TLS certificate pinning and jailbreak detection mechanisms conforming to OWASP mobile security standards.
Mentored incoming junior iOS developers on Swift idioms and architectural patterns.
points: Eliminated Git merge conflicts across multi-team codebases by automating iOS Xcode project generation with xcodegen, significantly reducing developer build friction.
Protected user communications against network tampering by engineering cryptographic TLS certificate pinning and client-side jailbreak detection algorithms compliant with OWASP Mobile standards.
Accelerated team onboarding by mentoring junior engineers in Swift concurrency, modular boundaries, and memory management best practices.

work.summary: Pioneered internationalization and adaptation of flagship banking solutions for international markets.
highlights: Kicked off internationalization engineering adapting a major Polish banking app to the French market.
Conducted technical feasibility studies, led live client demo sessions, and partnered with DevOps to establish automated CI/CD pipelines.
points: Expanded banking footprint into international European markets by re-engineering localization engines, dynamic typography, and region-specific regulatory workflows.
Accelerated release delivery cycles by enabling and configuring automated CI/CD pipelines utilizing Jenkins and Fastlane to automate test verification and build generation.

work.summary: Built full-lifecycle native iOS applications featuring offline persistence, live media streaming, and in-app transactions.
highlights: Developed a comprehensive Bible reader iOS app featuring verse bookmarking, highlighting, cloud data synchronization, and StoreKit In-App Purchases.
Engineered a real estate client app enabling live video property tours and cloud archiving using the Twilio SDK.
Mentored junior team members in Objective-C, memory management, and Cocoa Touch frameworks.

projects.name: Mobile Banking E-Commerce & 3D Secure
projects.description: High-scale modular iOS banking application serving millions of Polish banking clients, featuring secure e-commerce, biometric authentication, and 3D Secure payments.
highlights: Led a cross-functional squad of 15 FTEs (iOS, Android, Backend, QA) coordinating Scrum ceremonies, feature releases, and production incident RCA for a tier-1 Polish bank
Delivered modular SwiftUI architecture with snapshot regression tests, biometric authentication, 3D Secure, and strict OWASP security compliance

projects.name: E-Grocery AI Assistant Module
projects.description: AI-powered shopping assistant integrated into a leading Polish e-grocery app, accelerating user checkout and recipe item discovery.
highlights: Led end-to-end delivery of an AI shopping assistant with an 8-person team (3 BE, 3 FE, 2 QA), managing rollout to production release in August 2025
Guided the transition from initial Flutter PoC to production React Native module integrated into the native host app

projects.name: Atomic SwiftUI Component Library
projects.description: Reusable UI system adhering to Atomic Design principles, enabling consistent, accessible interface design across multiple automotive and enterprise apps.
highlights: Partnered closely with UX designers in Figma to translate design tokens into reusable code and establish shared UI conventions across apps
Designed and implemented a reusable UI component library in SwiftUI adhering to Atomic Design principles

projects.name: WalkieTalkie (Open Source)
projects.description: Real-time low-latency iOS audio transmission app communicating via custom UDP socket streaming and background audio handling.
highlights: Real-time low-latency UDP packet streaming and buffer manipulation in Swift
CoreAudio integration and automated background audio reconnection
